entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.7+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- The changelog now shows FOE+'s own updates by @phckd
- Fix "Wait 5 seconds." in chat: background commands keep 6 s away from yours and from each other by @phckd
- If the server still says to wait, FOE+ hides that line and tries again after the wait by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.6+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Background commands (contest refresh, silent /menu) wait until no menu is open by @phckd
- Contest refresh no longer runs while the Auction House or your inventory is open by @phckd
- Fix FPS drops while fishing: the bobber light no longer rebuilds chunks every tick by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.1+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Fix a memory leak that slowed the game down over long sessions and could crash it by @phckd
- Bait and pet price sheets retry every 2 minutes when they can't load, instead of nonstop by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.0+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- First FOE+ release, renamed from FOE-R (settings, stats and dry streaks carry over) by @phckd
- Fix menus freezing, where you could move but clicks, casting and NPCs stopped working by @phckd
- Fix FPS drops in menus and with many HUD panels by @phckd
- Bessie shows once during a moon, with the moon odds by @phckd
- Remove the Last Fabled record until it's reworked by @phckd
- Infusion Capsule chat alert, dry streak and All-Time Stats row by @phckd
- Witching Hour no longer pops up at noon by @phckd
- HUD panels keep their spot and only move up or down to avoid another panel by @phckd
- Alerts panel: Witching Hour, Titanoboa, Bessie, Rougarou, Garaboncias and Fabled events with timers by @phckd
- Moon timer synced to the server's moon cycle by @phckd
- Luck & Scale panel read from your /menu profile, boosters included by @phckd
- Daily Quests panel updates on every catch by @phckd
- Contest panel always shows the top 3, the fish you need, and updates on a new personal best by @phckd
- Exact pet per location, with a wrong-pet warning you can hide with - by @phckd
- Pet panel shows your pet's held item by @phckd
- Chat lines for pet pulls, variants and Gigantic catches with dry streaks by @phckd
- Import dry streaks and stats from old FOE and FOE-R installs, newer streaks are never overwritten by @phckd
- Edit Dry Streaks screen in the O menu by @phckd
- Personal Vault sorting by amount or rarity, and rank badges on locked pages by @phckd
- Auto Tip with badges, Inspect always-on toggle, and a + after other FOE+ users' names by @phckd
- New O menu with the FOE+ logo by @phckd

FOE+ is built on FishonMC-Extras-R, with features from FOECollab and FishOnAutotip.
